title: Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup
description: A bright, hearty chicken soup with orzo, spinach, and a lemon-dill finish. Comfort food that actually has good macros.

ingredients.name: kosher salt, plus more to taste
black pepper, plus more to taste

instructions.text: Heat {0} olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add {1} carrots, {2} celery, and {3} onion. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5–7 minutes.
Stir in {4} garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Sprinkle in {5} flour and stir well, letting it cook for about a minute.
Slowly pour in {6} chicken bone broth while stirring to keep the soup smooth. Add {7} Italian seasoning, then nestle {8} chicken breasts into the pot. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until the chicken is fully cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Remove the chicken and cut or shred into bite-sized pieces. Return to the pot and stir in {9} orzo.
Continue simmering, stirring often, until the orzo is al dente, about 10 minutes. Add {10} spinach and stir until wilted.
Finish with {11} lemon juice, the zest of {12} lemon, {13} fresh dill, and {14} Parmesan. Season with {15} salt and {16} black pepper. Taste and adjust lemon and seasoning before serving.

notes: Orzo continues to absorb liquid as it sits — if reheating leftovers, add a splash of broth to loosen. Lemon juice and dill are listed as starting amounts; taste and add more at the end, both brighten considerably. Parmesan can be skipped to make this dairy-free.
